q: What does Habakkuk ask Yahweh at the beginning of his complaint?
a: Habakkuk asks Yahweh how long he must cry for help without being heard or saved.
Yahweh went out for the salvation of his people and his anointed one.

q: Despite the hardships, what will Habakkuk do?
a: Despite the hardships, Habakkuk will exult in Yahweh and rejoice in the God of his salvation.
